시편-91-1.title: 시편 91장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-91-1.exegesis: 17. let the beauty-- or sum of His gracious acts, in their harmony, be illustrated in us, and favor our enterprise.
시편-91-1.theologicalNote: 17. let the beauty-- or sum of His gracious acts, in their harmony, be illustrated in us, and favor our enterprise.

시편-91-2.title: 시편 91장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-91-2.exegesis: PSALM 91 Psa 91:1-16 . David is the most probable author; and the pestilence, mentioned in 2Sa 24:13-15 , the most probable of any special occasion to which the Psalm may refer. The changes of person allowable in poetry are here frequently made. 1. dwelleth in the secret place-- ( Psa 27:5 ; 31:20 ) denotes nearness to God. Such as do so abide or lodge secure from assaults, and can well use the terms of trust in Psa 91:2 .

시편-91-8.title: 시편 91장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-91-8.exegesis: 7-8. The security is more valuable, as being special, and, therefore, evidently of God; and while ten thousands of the wicked fall, the righteous are in such safety that they only see the calamity.

시편-91-15.title: 시편 91장 15절 역사문법적 주해
